items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer introduces George Wettling as a fact ('George Wettling, the dixieland drummer, studied with Stuart Davis...') and the interviewee does not respond to this introduction with any personal anecdote, memory, or acknowledgment of a personal relationship.

ctx.x: It is true, yes. Tony Bennett. Yeah, there’s something . . .
The other art forms, certainly there seems to be something, the visual and the aural. There obviously seems to be a connection.
